description: When the Trial starts: - 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks. - The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks. While you are at least 24m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, any Generator that isn't being repaired regresses at 200% speed. When the Survivor is no longer hooked this effect ends in 20/25/30s.
While within 28/26/24m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers. While more than 28/26/24m away from a Survivor, gain 7% Haste.
Other Survivors unhook you 65/70/75% faster. Whenever you are unhooked, you gain 7% more Haste.

The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token. For each Token: - Gain 4% Haste while carrying a Survivor. - Hook Survivors 4% faster. When you have 4 Tokens, all Survivors: - Scream. - Gain Exposed for 60/65/70s.

When the trial starts, and after a Generator is completed, you earn 1 Token, up to 5. When the Killer gets within 20m of you, spend 1 Token. Then, for the next 13/14/15s: - You see the Auras of Pallets and Windows within 32m. - You see the Auras of other Survivors. - You see the Killer's Aura.
You basic-vault Windows 15% faster. Your successful basic-attack cooldown is 13/14/15% shorter. Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned the duration is 15% longer.
You do not scare Crows or scream. You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, and 23/24/25% faster.
